title: Repair October 27 learner retest regressions and home dark contrast

acceptance.text: Home news and BJT level cards remain readable in dark mode
Repair confirmed outstanding learner retest regressions without fabricating data

spec.expected_behavior: Filter the reported refusal, use the same recommendation limit, render spotlight once, and improve the identified dark-mode contrast.
spec.observed_behavior: A refusal gloss remains visible, recommendations use different limits, a spotlight is repeated, and some home and NHK warning colors have poor dark contrast.
spec.rollback_plan: Revert the task commit and restore the previous release; no schema changes in these edits.
